description: Source code for a graphics performance benchmarking application demonstrating texture resizing and creation effects in OpenGL ES, based on ANGLE project samples.

classes.name: TexRedefBenchSample
classes.description: A class that performs texture resizing and creation performance benchmarking in OpenGL ES.

methods.name: defineSquareTexture2D
methods.description: Defines a square 2D texture with specified dimensions and data.

methods.name: createPixelData
methods.description: Creates pixel data for textures used in benchmarking.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL program, textures, and pixel data.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Performs rendering and measures draw times for textures with different creation and resizing states.
